title: THE IMPOSSIBILITY THEOREM OF MACHINE FAIRNESS: A CAUSAL PERSPECTIVE
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical, structural, and mathematical aspects of machine fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, and Predictive Parity) using causal inference. While fairness is a concept within AI ethics, the paper treats it as a statistical and causal problem rather than engaging in religious, spiritual, or traditional moral-philosophical evaluation.
